lead: Kohn-Sham nonrepresentability transfer audit: qualitative fixed-budget barrier, exact ensemble approximation closure, and conditional extended-operator representations

interface.system: noninteracting fermions with spin-1/2 and one common real spin-independent local potential
interface.potential_budget: quotient sum norm modulo additive constants
interface.states: arbitrary normalized ground-state ensembles, including degeneracy
interface.target: three-electron Coulomb ground-state density from pinned OpenAI/math Theorem 1.1

claims.claim: For each finite C, the set of 3-electron spinful noninteracting ground-state ensemble densities generated by real spin-independent local potentials with quotient V-norm at most C is strongly closed in L1 intersect L3.
load_bearing_steps: Strong density convergence and bounded V-norm imply a uniform bound on ensemble kinetic energy through the ground-energy identity and one fixed smooth test determinant.
L1 density convergence gives joint configuration-space tightness for the fixed-N ensembles.
Kinetic boundedness plus tightness gives trace-norm compactness by cutoffs, Rellich compactness, and finite-rank projections.
Weak L^{3/2} and weak-* L-infinity subsequences yield a potential in the same norm ball; variational comparison makes the limiting ensemble a ground ensemble.
known_gaps: Independent hostile audit found no counterexample under the stated interface.
The result is a standard consequence of Lieb's lower-semicontinuous ensemble kinetic functional and closedness of its subdifferential graph; it is not a novelty-cleared advance.

claims.falsifier: A defect in the strong-X/weak-star closed-graph or variational compactness argument, failure of the Lieb/Brondsted-Rockafellar ensemble interface on X=L1 intersect L3, or a source proof defect affecting target nonrepresentability.

claims.claim: Conditional on the pinned source's Proposition 4.3, Proposition 5.1, and weighted gap (4.23), the source's formal local V=Delta g/(2g) defines a closable nonnegative minimal quadratic form on C_c^infinity. Its Friedrichs realization has g/sqrt(2) as a ground orbital, h as a d-energy first excited orbital, and the source target density as an exact three-electron spinful noninteracting ground-state density.
